[d/g2074788f713e-1] decision (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Route all time readings through a process-wide session clock.

[d/g2074788f713e-11] decision (cited, source crates/ucal/src/clock.rs@2074788f713e)
  Ignore poison on the session mutex and take the inner value.

[d/g2074788f713e-4] decision (cited, source crates/ucal/src/clock.rs@2074788f713e)
  Make Session::reading a pure function of its inputs.

[d/g2074788f713e-7] decision (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Split wall_instant out of now_instant to expose a raw system clock reading.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-7-1

[d/g2074788f713e-9] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@2074788f713e)
  Document the session clock and its rule in CLI.md and release notes.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-9-1

[d/g21665b3aac9b-1] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Set RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings in features.yml workflow

[d/g21665b3aac9b-2] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Fix the six items with cfg attributes rather than warning suppressions
  -> causes q/g21665b3aac9b-2-1

[d/g21665b3aac9b-3] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Gate RatInterval import behind feature cosmo
  RatInterval is only parse_redshift's return type and nothing else's, so it arrives with cosmo or not at all.
  -> causes q/g21665b3aac9b-3-1

[d/g21665b3aac9b-4] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Gate qualified::Kind import behind feature civil
  -> causes q/g21665b3aac9b-4-1

[d/g21665b3aac9b-5] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Gate Rounding import behind feature civil

[d/g21665b3aac9b-6] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Gate parse_form and codec::Form behind all(civil, std)

[d/g21665b3aac9b-7] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Gate years_quantity behind any(events, cosmo)

[d/g21665b3aac9b-9] decision (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  Split sign-release error message into two messages based on gh auth status

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-1] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Add a clock section to doctor and now output.

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-2] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Add doctor --clock flag to sample and report machine resolution.

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-3] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Keep precision field name and value unchanged.
  -> causes q/g31e52cc10b1f-3-1

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-4] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Do not measure accuracy.

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-5] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Keep granularity, resolution, and accuracy as separate numbers.

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-6] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Report which error terms cancel in a difference.

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-8] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@31e52cc10b1f)
  Add note that precision is tier rendered to, not accuracy.

[d/g449b762e3cca-10] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Refuse calendars with no anchor
  The same error as the forward direction, UCAL-E0062; thirteen of fifteen derived calendars are in this state.

[d/g449b762e3cca-11] decision (cited, source git:449b762e3cca6dc1d2b9b2838a4ecafbd541dcf2)
  Add property test recovering every instant

[d/g449b762e3cca-12] decision (cited, source git:449b762e3cca6dc1d2b9b2838a4ecafbd541dcf2)
  Assert consecutive local days leave no gap
  -> causes q/g449b762e3cca-12-1

[d/g449b762e3cca-2] decision (cited, source git:449b762e3cca6dc1d2b9b2838a4ecafbd541dcf2)
  Return a Window from the inverse
  -> causes q/g449b762e3cca-2-1

[d/g449b762e3cca-3] decision (cited, source git:449b762e3cca6dc1d2b9b2838a4ecafbd541dcf2)
  Parse the exact form `cal show` prints

[d/g449b762e3cca-4] decision (cited, source git:449b762e3cca6dc1d2b9b2838a4ecafbd541dcf2)
  Take window endpoints outward, never inward

[d/g449b762e3cca-5] decision (cited, source git:449b762e3cca6dc1d2b9b2838a4ecafbd541dcf2)
  Do not use search to find the year
  -> causes q/g449b762e3cca-5-1

[d/g449b762e3cca-6] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Refuse year 0
  Local years are 1-based from the anchor; year 1 is the year that began there, and there is no year 0.
  -> causes q/g449b762e3cca-6-1

[d/g449b762e3cca-7] decision (cited, source crates/ucal-body/src/calendar.rs@449b762e3cca)
  Refuse day 0
  -> causes q/g449b762e3cca-7-1

[d/g449b762e3cca-8] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Refuse a day past the year's end, not roll it forward
  -> causes q/g449b762e3cca-8-1

[d/g449b762e3cca-9] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Refuse a fraction of 1 or more
  A fraction through a day lies in [0, 1); 1 is the next day, not the end of this one.
  -> causes q/g449b762e3cca-9-1

[d/g5880e472260e-1] decision (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  Read notes for version being built rather than newest sorted file
  Sorting filenames picked newest by lexicographic order, causing 1.10.0 to be missed. Deriving the version from [workspace.package] removes ordering and avoids guessing.

[d/g5880e472260e-3] decision (cited, source xtask/src/citations.rs@5880e472260e)
  Replace old version-sort tests with current-version and missing-notes tests
  -> causes q/g5880e472260e-3-1

[d/g5880e472260e-5] decision (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  Restore doc comment for check_ci_covers_the_procedure

[d/g5880e472260e-6] decision (cited, source Documentation/Release_Notes/1.10.0.md@5880e472260e)
  Update release notes with the fix rationale and sweep findings

[d/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2] decision (cited, source git:8fdb9b3edb7cc175c1f940966840fdc24a6ad03c)
  Accept broken pipe as non-fatal when writing test stdin.

[d/gcc3aafefb1da-1] decision (cited, source git:cc3aafefb1da326e130fd890c1d575969cee7a2a)
  Replace test-written temp fixture with committed observations file.
  -> causes q/gcc3aafefb1da-1-1

[d/gcc3aafefb1da-4] decision (cited, source Documentation/Release_Notes/1.12.0.md@cc3aafefb1da)
  Add release note documenting flaky test and repair.
  -> causes q/gcc3aafefb1da-4-1

[d/gcc3aafefb1da-5] decision (cited, source git:cc3aafefb1da326e130fd890c1d575969cee7a2a)
  Keep 'no observations read' as error rather than agreement.
  Comparing nothing should not be a report of agreement.
  -> causes q/gcc3aafefb1da-5-1

[d/gcc3aafefb1da-6] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI-EXAMPLES.md@cc3aafefb1da)
  Do not fit or extract quadratic trend (Ṗ) from residuals.
  -> causes q/gcc3aafefb1da-6-1

[p/g21665b3aac9b-3-1] constraint (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  parse_redshift is compiled only when feature cosmo is enabled.
  -> conditions d/g21665b3aac9b-3

[p/g21665b3aac9b-7-1] constraint (cited, source git:21665b3aac9be9a762eada806b9ccb56c3cbabea)
  years_quantity is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends, and by no other …
  years_quantity is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends, and by no other features.
  -> conditions d/g21665b3aac9b-7

[p/g449b762e3cca-10-1] constraint (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Forward direction already returns `UCAL-E0062` for unanchored calendars.
  -> conditions d/g449b762e3cca-10

[p/g449b762e3cca-6-1] constraint (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Local years are 1-based from anchor; year 1 is the year that began there.
  -> conditions d/g449b762e3cca-6

[p/g449b762e3cca-9-1] constraint (cited, source crates/ucal-body/src/calendar.rs@449b762e3cca)
  `Ratio` provides `cmp_exact` and `Ratio::one` for exact comparison.
  -> conditions d/g449b762e3cca-9

[p/g5880e472260e-1-1] constraint (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  The workspace version is declared under [workspace.package] in Cargo.toml.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-1

[p/g5880e472260e-1-2] constraint (cited, source xtask/src/citations.rs@5880e472260e)
  Release notes are stored as {version}.md files under Documentation/Release_Notes.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-1

[p/gcc3aafefb1da-5-1] constraint (cited, source git:cc3aafefb1da326e130fd890c1d575969cee7a2a)
  The residuals command currently returns error when no observations are read
  -> conditions d/gcc3aafefb1da-5

[q/g2074788f713e-5-1] claim (inferred)
  last prevents smaller elapsed inputs from making reading go backwards.

[q/g2074788f713e-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Option avoids .expect, allows anchoring where failure can be returned.

[q/g2074788f713e-7-1] claim (inferred)
  wall_instant exposes raw system clock for doctor --clock and measurements.

[q/g2074788f713e-9-1] claim (inferred)
  Documents one process, one clock and max rule in CLI.md and release notes.

[q/g21665b3aac9b-2-1] claim (inferred)
  Six items fixed with cfg attributes, not warning suppressions.

[q/g21665b3aac9b-3-1] claim (inferred)
  RatInterval import is gated to cosmo because only parse_redshift uses it.

[q/g21665b3aac9b-4-1] claim (inferred)
  qualified::Kind import is gated to civil because to-civil reads it.

[q/g31e52cc10b1f-3-1] claim (inferred)
  Keeping precision unchanged avoids breaking ucal-json/1 paths.

[q/g449b762e3cca-12-1] claim (inferred)
  Consecutive local days leave no gap.

[q/g449b762e3cca-2-1] claim (inferred)
  The inverse returns a Window, an interval, not a point.

[q/g449b762e3cca-5-1] claim (inferred)
  The inverse evaluates directly without iterative search.

[q/g449b762e3cca-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Year 0 is refused with error E0020.

[q/g449b762e3cca-7-1] claim (inferred)
  Day 0 is refused with error E0018.

[q/g449b762e3cca-8-1] claim (inferred)
  Days beyond the year's end are refused, not rolled forward.

[q/g449b762e3cca-9-1] claim (inferred)
  Fractions of 1 or more are refused.

[q/g5880e472260e-3-1] claim (inferred)
  Old version-sort tests replaced with current-version and missing-notes tests.

[q/gcc3aafefb1da-1-1] claim (inferred)
  Committed fixture cannot race and a reader can open it.

[q/gcc3aafefb1da-4-1] claim (inferred)
  Release note records CI found the flaky test and the repair.

[q/gcc3aafefb1da-5-1] claim (inferred)
  No observations read remains an error, not a report of agreement.

[q/gcc3aafefb1da-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Residuals command does not fit or extract quadratic trend (Ṗ).

[r/g449b762e3cca-10-1] claim (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Rejected: Allow the inverse for calendars with no anchor.
  The same error as the forward direction, UCAL-E0062, applies; thirteen of fifteen derived calendars are in this state.
  -> contrasts d/g449b762e3cca-10

[r/g449b762e3cca-2-1] claim (cited, source git:449b762e3cca6dc1d2b9b2838a4ecafbd541dcf2)
  Rejected: Return an exact instant rather than a Window.
  A local day is a span and the anchor's uncertainty propagates, so the answer must be an interval.
  -> contrasts d/g449b762e3cca-2

[r/g449b762e3cca-6-1] claim (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Rejected: Accept year 0 as the year before the anchor's year 1.
  Local years are 1-based from the anchor, and year 1 is the year that began there.
  -> contrasts d/g449b762e3cca-6

[r/g449b762e3cca-9-1] claim (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@449b762e3cca)
  Rejected: Treat fraction 1 as the end of the current day.
  A fraction through a day lies in [0, 1), and 1 is the next day rather than the end of this one.
  -> contrasts d/g449b762e3cca-9
